$comment: How the desktop app reads the bundled agent's typing switch, `input_automation.enabled` (T-1307).
The app starts its agent with no config flag, so the agent reads its default config file; the app
reads that same file (and the same AURA_INPUT_ENABLED override) before it registers the dictation key,
and with the switch off it does not register the key at all. This table is the agent's own reading
the app's logic/src/dictation.rs tests both read it, so the two cannot drift apart. `enabled` is false
for anything the agent would not read as on: a missing file, a missing key, a wrong type, an
unrecognised word. `env` is AURA_INPUT_ENABLED (null = unset; an empty string is set and wins).
`config` is the config file's text (null = no file). `unreadable` marks text the agent refuses to
start on; the app fails closed on it too.

switch.name: a word the agent reads as on
a number is not a switch
an empty env is set and wins
an unrecognised env word is off, not the file's
top level is not an object
